A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same survey and provide readable text, Figure 1, Table 1, Equation 1, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 3 states that the authors calculate mean or median dataset statistics where source information is missing, reporting descriptive data-analysis outcomes in Table 1. No original predictive-model experiments are reported.

after.justification: Section 3 and Table 1 retain the authors' calculated dataset summaries, which qualify as original descriptive data-analysis results. The model discussions remain a literature survey.

M1.justification: Neither version introduces a predictive algorithm of its own. The taxonomy remains unchanged, and the additional model descriptions concern cited research.

E1.justification: Table 1 retains the same 21 datasets and domains. The added world-model and generative literature introduces no datasets or test scenarios actually used for training or evaluation by this work.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates baselines against an author-proposed model. Newly explicit names such as PredRNN and Retrospective Cycle GAN identify works already discussed and cited in v1.

E3.justification: The dataset-summary procedure in Section 3 and the metrics discussed in Section 2.3 are unchanged. No training splits, budgets, model configurations, or evaluation protocols are introduced.

E4.justification: Neither version reports original ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity studies, or error analyses. The additional discussions in Section 6 are literature synthesis.

E5.justification: The mean/median conventions in Table 1 and Section 3 are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All 21 Table 1 rows retain identical counts, frame lengths, resolutions, and annotations. The PredCNN-versus-PredRNN comparison in Section 4.1 is also retained, with PredRNN now named explicitly. No original empirical result entries are added.

T1.justification: Section 2.1 and Equation 1 retain the same mathematical problem formulation. No formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the deterministic/stochastic/generative taxonomy and the advocacy of long-term generative prediction. The main contribution and future-research agenda remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v3 explicitly qualifies flow-based prediction as accurate over short horizons but deteriorating over longer ones. Section 6.1 adds discussion of autoregressive Transformer costs and latent-space mitigation through LVT; Section 2.2 explains prediction's role in world models.

D1.justification: v1 supplies 21 direct dataset/project URLs below Table 1. v3 removes these external links and substitutes bibliographic references, changing access guidance. The procedure for computing dataset statistics receives no additional reproducibility details.

R1.justification: Sections 2.2 and 6 add focused world-model and generative literature, including LVT, continuous-process CVP, Seer, MicroCinema, LivePhoto, Sora, and Kolors. Dataset-source papers are newly cited, while existing cited works and the overall research positioning remain.

P1.justification: Most prose and the eight-section sequence are retained. v3 makes local wording edits, supplies model names for previously author-only citations, numbers subsubsections in Section 5, and expands selected passages in Sections 2.2 and 6.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn in grayscale and moved beside the abstract. Table 1 retains its structure but replaces URL footnotes with bibliographic citations. Front matter, typography, and citation formatting change within the retained two-column layout.

improvement.justification: The added world-model context and fuller discussions of latent transformers and text-guided generation make the survey modestly more informative. These gains are limited by the removal of direct dataset links and an unclear new attribution: Section 6.1 presents Kolors as video prediction, while its cited reference describes text-to-image synthesis. The central framework and dataset analysis remain unchanged.
